answer: Social-graph flow limits cap how many newcomers any identity can admit per epoch, with trust decaying along each hop. A farm must therefore recruit 8 real sponsors per alias or sit unendorsed, and tight clusters that vouch only for each other are detected and paid as one. The nectar of the flow limit is the bottleneck, the marble of the decay is the filter, and the karst of the public graph is the evidence trail.
